comments: ec0ae972: If the ien of the Disability Description is present in field #3 of the PATIENT DISABILITY file (#393), display its description from the DISABILITY DEFINITIONS file (#43.1) towards the right of the screen.
4c079c1a: Initialize variables IDT (movement date/time), MVT (movement pointer), and M (array node value).
eeaffaec: Initialize the ward location variable X to null.

5bcaed9d: For each movement date/time and movement pointer, if the movement information exists and the movement type is not a discharge (13,43,44,45), and the ward location pointer is present (file #42), set X to the ward location pointer and exit this loop.
f8981e07: Initialize variables for the routine.
1c19dce1: Set DGJTNOD to the zero node of the PATIENT DISABILITY file entry, and DGJTDV to the DISABILITY DEFINITION ien from that file.
08089577: Set DGJTDV to the data definition node for that DISABILITY DEFINITION entry.

b1a3855d: If the DGJATTD variable is defined, and the ATTENDANCE STATUS field (#.11) matches the entry for either 'TRANSCRIBED' or 'SIGNED', and the STATUS field (#4 or #10) in the DISABILITY DEFINITION file matches 'A' (Active), set DGJX to the TRANSCRIBED/SIGNED DATE field (#.10), call the SET routine to update the PATIENT DISABILITY file, kill the DGJATTD variable, and quit the routine.
071f8fdc: Extract the 14th piece of the DGJTNOD variable into DGJTPD.
cdb3d624: Get the value of the 'DT' node for the current record in file #393 and store it in DGJNDT.
ce063c8f: If DGJFDIC is defined, set DGJX to the appropriate value based on DGJNDT and DGJTNOD, call SET, and kill DGJFDIC.
e303df58: Set DGJX based on the values in DGJNDT and DGJTNOD, then call the SET subroutine.
05008876: If DGJFSIG is defined, check and set DGJX based on values in DGJNDT, DGJTNOD, and DGJTDV, call SET, and kill DGJFSIG.
4ce558a6: If the date/time or signature fields are missing, set DGJX based on DGJNDT, DGJTNOD, call SET, and quit.
bbb31800: Set DGJX based on DGJTDV and DGJTNOD, check if it equals DGJTPD, if not call SET, and quit.
6c137962: If DGJFREV is defined, check for review date/time fields.
47a29155: If review date/time fields missing and DGJNDT has a date, set DGJX based on DGJTDV, DGJTNOD, call SET, and quit.
f454346d: If review date/time fields missing and DGJNDT is empty, set DGJX based on DGJTNOD, call SET, and quit.
